name: Media Processing
description: Media Processing with shared sandbox development tools.
smokeTest: ffmpeg -version; convert -version; python -c "from PIL import Image; import cv2; import numpy as n; Image.new('RGB', (16,16)).save('/tmp/image.png'); assert cv2.imread('/tmp/image.png').shape == (16,16,3)"; ffmpeg -v error -f lavfi -i color=c=black:s=16x16:d=1 -c:v libx264 /tmp/video.mp4
